findings.evidence: plan.md proposes exposure checkpoint only after Tool result; activation mutates process memory before later ReAct CAS, so crash can leave succeeded effect without recoverable activated schema.
findings.root_cause: Activation mutation, Tool effect settlement, context append and checkpoint advancement lack one durable commit protocol.

findings.evidence: Existing ToolCatalogSnapshot stores ProviderToolSpec only; plan names no durable schema/repository/runtime resolver for source descriptors, modes, aliases, locators or search facts.
findings.root_cause: Public catalog is not connected to a durable storage schema and Runtime resolver.

findings.evidence: Plan models Tools, MCP, Skill metadata and Workflow metadata as homogeneous RuntimeToolSourceRecord without discriminated kind/loader/projection semantics.
findings.root_cause: Heterogeneous discovery resources are modeled as homogeneous executable Tools.

findings.evidence: Current ReAct serializes ToolResult as TOOL; plan asserts USER/untrusted Skill body without typed ingress, compaction or redaction seam.
findings.root_cause: Skill instruction trust channel lacks an SDK message/control contract and bounded private projection path.

findings.evidence: MCP handlers hot-replace by qualified name; plan lacks monotonic server incarnation and immutable per-Run dispatch token.
findings.root_cause: Catalog freezes logical name while MCP execution authority is mutable live session state.

findings.evidence: CAP-2 lacks exact localhost URL/title/readiness; CAP-3 lacks document path/hash/heading tree/Skill locator.
findings.root_cause: Manual oracles freeze prompts but not deterministic fixtures and expected observations.

findings.evidence: Plan publishes immutable wheel before final Host/UI cutover validation and lacks previous 0.4.0 pin rollback procedure.
findings.root_cause: Release validation is ordered after irreversible publication and lacks rollback.
